text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower isn't looking well, so I
take her to
the infirmary to get some
rest.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm really sorry for this. I'll get
better right
away, so please just wait a
little while.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! We've been looking
all over for
you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U-um... You were looking for me?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
We need an older student to supervise our
training session today, and that's
you, Flower! I've
really been looking
forward to this!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Older... student... I'm all grown up now!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... So? What did you think of my running?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Your final spurt was picture
perfect.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But I thought your overall pace during
the lap was
a little inconsistent.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see! Thank you so much for your
advice!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...U-um! If you have the time to spare,
could you
help me with my homework
after this?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wha—hey! She's already promised to
watch over
my training session next!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Well, then I can wait until after you're
done!
Please, Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
O-of course. I'd be more than happy to
help!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, but let's all calm down a little...
I'll
help you
all in order!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Are you sure it's not too much?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Not to worry. After all, I'm everyone's...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Dependable senior!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Was that... a dream? But those
smiles...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll make them a reality one day! I just
need to do
my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After having a wonderful dream, Nishino
Flower
feels thoroughly refreshed in
both mind and
body.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: No fair! I was going to ask her to help me study after training!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A and B
text_block_list.text:
She can help you tomorrow!
No, you can
be the one to wait!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: E-excuse me! There's no need to—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Was that... a dream? What a relief,
but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I guess I've still got a long way to go
before
everyone sees me as a
dependable senior...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower has a bad dream, and her

condition fails to improve.
